environment.description: Same Tomcat application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. PostgreSQL 14.6 on RDS. The database connection is proxied through PgBouncer 1.19 configured in transaction pooling mode with a custom query parser module (pgbouncer-rr with routing rules). The database role 'report_app_ro' is configured with a restricted search_path and column-level SELECT grants only on explicitly listed columns per table. Additionally, a pg_query_filter extension (based on pg_stat_statements hooks) is loaded that enforces a statement allowlist: only queries matching pre-registered parameterized patterns are permitted to execute; any statement containing SQL keywords in column-position expressions (detected via libpg_query AST parsing of the SELECT list) that don't match a registered template triggers an immediate connection termination and alert.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with default rules (no WAF ACL attached)
config.db_permissions: Column-level SELECT grants only: GRANT SELECT (row_num, col_a, col_b, col_c, col_d, col_e) ON report_data_% TO report_app_ro; search_path = 'reporting' (immutable via ALTER ROLE SET)
config.query_filter: pg_query_filter extension loaded via shared_preload_libraries; statement allowlist with AST-level validation of SELECT-list expressions; rejects any query where SELECT-list contains function calls, subqueries, UNION, or references to tables outside current search_path; connection terminated on violation
config.pgbouncer_config: transaction_pooling; server_reset_query = 'DISCARD ALL; SET search_path TO reporting'; max_client_conn = 100
